data.action: 穿居家服侧卧，九尾围在身侧，脸颊轻靠近处手掌。
data.description: 铃兰穿奶油黄绒面居家服侧卧在床上，九条尾巴松松围成柔软的弧形。她把脸颊轻靠在近处伸来的手掌，安静听着故事。
data.promptProse: Lying peacefully on her side across the dormitory bed in her closed cream fleece hoodie and matching shorts, Suzuran lets her nine fluffy tails settle in a soft crescent along the rumpled bedding. She nestles her cheek trustingly against a comforting hand reaching in from beside the bed, her eyes resting shut with a serene smile as she listens to a quiet late-night story. Cool silver moonlight streams through the bedroom window, outlining her pillow, fleece collar, and the soft arc of her fur.
data.title: 铃兰 · 九尾陪伴
data.animaCaption: Lying on her side on the dormitory bed in her cream fleece sleepwear, Suzuran rests her cheek gently against a hand reaching in beside the pillow while her nine tails curve along the sheets. Quiet moonlight from the window softly illuminates her peaceful expression.
